subtitle: 國中程度引導式短文：用未來式寫出三件暑假想做的事
task: Summer vacation is coming. Write a short passage of 60–100 words about your plan for the vacation. In your passage, (1) write about three things you want to do, (2) give a reason for at least one of them, and (3) say how you feel about the coming vacation.
taskZh: 暑假快到了。寫一篇 60–100 字的英文短文介紹你的暑假計畫：(1) 寫出三件你想做的事，(2) 至少說明其中一件事的原因，(3) 說說你對這個暑假的感覺。
focus: 內容：寫出三件事，並說明原因與感受
文法：用 want to、plan to、be going to、hope to 表達未來的計畫
組織：用 First、Second、Third 把三件事排列清楚
拼字與標點：句首大寫、句尾加句點

en: This summer vacation, I want to do three things. First, I plan to read at least five English storybooks because I want to improve my reading. Second, I am going to learn how to swim. My older brother swims very well, and he promised to teach me. Third, I hope to visit my grandparents in Hualien for a week. They live near the sea, so we can ride bikes along the coast together. I think this summer will be busy but fun.
zh: 這個暑假，我想做三件事。第一，我打算讀至少 5 本英文故事書，因為我想加強閱讀能力。第二，我要學游泳。我哥哥很會游泳，他答應要教我。第三，我希望去花蓮的爺爺奶奶家住一個星期。他們住在海邊，所以我們可以一起沿著海岸騎腳踏車。我想這個暑假會很忙，但也會很好玩。

patterns.zh: 說出第一件計畫，並說明原因
patterns.example: First, I plan to read at least five English storybooks because I want to improve my reading.

patterns.pattern: I am going to learn how to …
patterns.zh: 用 be going to 說出要學的事
patterns.example: Second, I am going to learn how to swim.

patterns.zh: 用 hope to 說出希望做到的事
patterns.example: Third, I hope to visit my grandparents in Hualien for a week.

patterns.zh: 結尾說出對未來的感覺
patterns.example: I think this summer will be busy but fun.

parts: My older brother swims very well.
combine.answer: My older brother swims very well, and he promised to teach me.

parts: We can ride bikes along the coast together.
combine.answer: They live near the sea, so we can ride bikes along the coast together.

paraphrase.sentence: I want to improve my reading.
answers: I hope to become a better reader.

paraphrase.sentence: This summer will be busy but fun.
answers: I will be busy this summer, but I will have fun.
This summer will be full of things to do, and it will be fun.
